description: Implementation of the CoalescingCertVerifier class, which groups multiple certificate verification requests into a single job to optimize resource usage and manage lifetime complexities. Contains classes for Job and Request handling, verification logic, and request management.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Job
classes.description: Represents a single verification job that manages request attachment, verification process, and callback notification.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Request
classes.description: Represents an individual verification request attached to a Job, handles completion and cancellation.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Verify
methods.description: Main method to initiate a certificate verification, either attaching to an existing job or creating a new one.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::SetConfig
methods.description: Sets the verifier configuration and resets current jobs to be unjoinable.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the underlying verifier.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the underlying verifier.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::FindJob
methods.description: Finds an existing joinable job matching the request parameters.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::RemoveJob
methods.description: Removes a job from the current or previous generation, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::IncrementGenerationAndMakeCurrentJobsUnjoinable
methods.description: Transitions current joinable jobs to in-flight and makes new jobs unjoinable.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the underlying verifier, resetting current jobs.
